tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page and app-frame background, and the sticky header at 92% opacity. From style.css.

tokens.name: cream-deep
tokens.usage: Resting borders on service rows, day chips and slots; dividers between reviews; the unavailable slot fill. From style.css.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Card and row surfaces (service rows, day chips, review card, confirm bar) and text on gold-deep. From style.css.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Header and footer rules, review card border, selected time-slot fill, hero button hover, social icon borders. From style.css. Text on it should be ink.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Decorative accent: the underline on text links and warm photo placeholders. Never carries text. From style.css.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: The action color: filled buttons, selected day chip, checked service circle, stars, active nav link, logo mark, focus ring. From style.css. FLAG: white text on it is 3.6:1 and gold-deep text on cream is 3.4:1, both under 4.5:1 for small text; use gold-ink where text must pass AA.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: AA-safe stand-in for gold-deep wherever it carries small text or a filled button: 6.3:1 with white text, 5.9:1 as text on cream. Added: not in style.css. Same hue, darker.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the hover fill of filled buttons, the hero button text. From style.css.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav links, prices, review text, captions. 5.8:1 on cream, 6.2:1 on white. From style.css.

tokens.name: unavailable
tokens.usage: Text on an unavailable time slot. From style.css. FLAG: about 1.6:1 on cream-deep. Acceptable only because the control is disabled; always add a strike-through so the state is not color alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form error text and the border of an invalid field. From style.css (it was hard-coded there, not a token). 5.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: photo-light
tokens.usage: Light stop of the default photo placeholder gradient (145deg). From style.css.

tokens.name: photo-deep
tokens.usage: Deep stop of the default photo placeholder gradient. From style.css.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Ink at 72% over the bottom of the hero photo so white text stays readable (style.css: rgba(43,36,32,0.72)). Fades to transparent upward.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The landing-screen name, centered, white on the hero photo. Once per app.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles (My Work, Book Now). Line height is inherited from body in style.css.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings on the booking screen. The Reviews heading is 1.2rem in style.css; treat them as one style.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The date number inside a day chip.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Exactly what I asked for, first try.
styles.usage: Default text. Jost 300 to 600 is loaded.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Select a day to see available times
styles.usage: Review text, placeholders, the confirm summary line, page intro (0.9rem in style.css).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Service names and other row labels. Time slots use 0.82rem at 400.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header links, letter-spacing 0.01em. The active link is weight 500 in gold-deep.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Filled buttons, letter-spacing 0.02em. The hero button is 0.85rem and the header Book button 0.8rem, both at 500 with 0.03em.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Weekday in a day chip, footer copyright (0.72rem), photo captions (0.65rem).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between day chips and time slots; between service rows (0.65rem).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Section heading to content; inside service rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between portfolio tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Header and hero side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margins and section padding: the most common value in style.css.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero overlay top padding; space before a closing action.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Time slots. From style.css.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Service rows and day chips. From style.css.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The reviews card. From style.css.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Portfolio photo tiles. From style.css.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button. From style.css.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The service check circle and social icon buttons. From style.css.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Portfolio photo tiles only. Service rows and review cards use a border instead of a shadow.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content on wide screens. The header, strip and footer bands are full width; their content sits in this container.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Forms, recaps, confirmations and help: single-purpose screens stay a readable column on desktop.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Width of a modal, and of a sheet once it becomes a centered dialog (sm and up).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky header. Sticky side panels sit just below it.

responsive.approach: Mobile first: the phone layout is the base and min-width queries add to it. CSS cannot read custom properties inside @media, so the breakpoint widths below are the only numbers that may appear in a min-width query (scripts/breakpoints.test.ts enforces it).

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.usage: Large phone and small tablet: two-column grids, sheets become centered dialogs, the wordmark appears.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.usage: Desktop: two-column compositions, sticky summary panels, larger display type, side gutters.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.usage: Wide desktop: three-column grids; content reaches the container maximum.

gutter.name: gutter
gutter.usage: Extra side padding supplied by the page container. Zero on a phone, because components keep their own space-5 side padding.

gutter.name: gutter
gutter.usage: Desktop side padding, on top of component padding, so content never touches the window edge.

type.name: display-xl
type.usage: The landing name grows on desktop.
